Mechanical Product Engineer- Generator Sets/Electrical Power Products 
 Seguin, TX  |  Full-Time
 
 Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full-time Mechanical Product Engineer- Generator Sets/Electrical Power Products to join our team in Mossville, IL. We offer full benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company - let's talk!
 
 Position Overview 
 In this role, you will be taking ownership of Retail and Rental gensets fueled by diesel primarily for North Americas region. You will be engineering contact for suppliers for CPPD, NPI, CPI and other Material cost reduction (MCR) projects . You will provide support to engineering team as SME on NPI and other maintenance projects those require complex calculations, redesign of existing product and integration without impacting production of current product. You will be providing shop support to solve complex technical problems, to maintain regular production to meet customer delivery dates.
 This role provides unique experience of working on electrical power products, you get opportunities to work on electromechanical designs 
  
 Key Responsibilities 
 •         Working knowledge of generator sets 
 •         Experience of PTC Creo (Formerly ProEngineer)
 •         Excellent communication skills
 •         Strong problem-solving abilities
  
 Top 3 Skills 
 •         Mechanical Engineering
 •         Shop Support
 •         Creo 
 
 Team & Work Environment 
 •         6 team members locally
 •         Global team members
 •         Collaborative 
 •         60% shop floor / 40% engineering project work
 •         PPE gear required- candidate need to have their own steel toe shoes 
 Requirements 
 Required Qualifications 
 •         Associate's degree in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 3 years' experience. - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Equivalent with minimum 2 years' experience. 
 •         Master’s degree in an Electrical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering 
 •         Projects/internships will be considered toward experience minimum, but durations must be listed on resumes.
 •         Experience of working in a factory / shop support environment
 •         Experience of creating and interpreting engineering drawings
 •         Experience of using a 2d/3d design package
  
 Soft Skills 
 •         Communication and Presentation skills 
 Benefits 
 401(k)
 Dental insurance
 Vision Insurance
 Disability insurance
 Employee assistance program
 Health insurance
 Health savings account
 Life insurance
 Paid time off
 Paid Holidays
 Please follow the link to our website for a list of job openings in Engineering, IT, Project Management, and more! https://www.dsnworldwide.com 
 
 Salary expectations: 70,000-76,000 per annual
